recipes.title: Garlic Soy Chicken and Broccoli Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Glossy garlic-soy chicken and crisp-tender broccoli crown fluffy rice in a hearty weeknight bowl.

ingredients.amount: 1 1/4 cups for rice plus 3 tablespoons for skillet

steps: Rinse the rice and combine with 1 1/4 cups water in a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes; remove from the heat and rest covered for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook for 7–9 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned.
Add the broccoli and 3 tablespoons water, cover, and steam for 3 minutes.
Uncover, add the garlic, soy sauce, and sugar if using, and stir for 2–3 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F and the broccoli is tender.
Fluff the rice and divide between bowls, then spoon the chicken and broccoli over it.
substitutions: Use boneless chicken breast cut into small pieces instead of thighs.
Replace soy sauce with gluten-free tamari.
tips: Cut the broccoli small so it cooks quickly.
Check the thickest chicken piece with an instant-read thermometer.

recipes.title: Chicken and Broccoli Garlic Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Sizzling rice mingles with golden chicken, chopped broccoli, and savory garlic-soy seasoning.
steps: Break up any clumps in the cooked rice.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it reaches 165°F; transfer to a clean plate.
Add the broccoli and water to the skillet, cover, and steam for 2 minutes.
Uncover, let excess water evaporate, and stir in the remaining oil and garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until hot, then add the chicken and soy sauce and stir for 2 minutes until steaming throughout.
Divide between plates and scatter with green onion if using.
substitutions: Use ready-to-heat brown rice instead of cooked white rice.
Use gluten-free tamari instead of soy sauce.
tips: This timing requires cooked rice, not dry rice.
Use a wide pan to fry the rice rather than steam it.

recipes.title: Chicken, Broccoli, and Rice Soup
recipes.summary: Tender chicken, rice, and bright broccoli simmer in a light garlic broth with a savory splash of soy sauce.
steps: Rinse the rice and cut the chicken and broccoli into small pieces.
Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds without browning.
Pour in the broth, add the rice, and bring to a boil.
Add the chicken, return to a simmer, and cook partially covered for 12 minutes.
Add the broccoli and simmer for 4–5 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Stir in the soy sauce and pepper if using and ladle into bowls.
substitutions: Replace chicken broth with vegetable broth.
Replace soy sauce with gluten-free tamari.
tips: Keep the soup at a gentle simmer after adding the chicken.
Add a splash of water when reheating because the rice absorbs broth.
